messages.name: Claude Code
messages.text: That explains it, James. Tapping a teammate's name in the iPhone app sends just their name right away, instead of letting you type the rest. I fixed it on the Mac side. When a message is only a name, like "Claude Code,", Jarvis now holds it and puts it in front of the next thing you send. "Claude Code," followed by "install the app" lands as one message: "Claude Code, install the app". If you don't send anything within 2 minutes, the name goes in on its own like before. The build worked, but I haven't tested it with a real tap. It takes effect after a "Restart Jarvis".

messages.name: Claude Code
messages.text: The proper fix (tapping a name should just start your message) is in the iPhone app, which Jarvis would need to hand me.

messages.name: Claude Code
messages.text: Jarvis is fully up to date, James: it restarted at 4:59 PM, after the last build. The name fix is live, so tap my name on your phone, then type your message, and it should arrive as one line.

messages.text: I don’t wanna add more noise to work it out and need a good place to feed my input to

messages.name: Claude Code
messages.text: Use your private Jarvis chat as the one place for all your input, James. Click Jarvis at the top of the strip and just dump thoughts there: ideas, bugs, "fix this later". The team doesn't see it, so it adds no noise, and Jarvis puts each item on the to-do list and offers to hand it to a teammate when you're ready. On your phone the private chat isn't there yet, so start messages with "Jarvis," in the team chat. If you want, I can bring the private chat to the iPhone later.

messages.name: Claude Code
messages.text: The Mac half of the private chat on the iPhone is done, James. The phone screen itself still needs building, and it's in the iPhone app's folder, which Jarvis has to hand me. - **Done on the Mac:** the Mac now accepts private messages for Jarvis from the phone, both at home and away, using the same conversation as the Mac's Jarvis tab. It also sends the private chat, Jarvis's answer buttons and a "thinking" signal back to the phone.

messages.name: Claude Code
messages.text: The build worked, and it takes effect after a "Restart Jarvis". - **Still to do on the phone:** a Jarvis tab in the iPhone app, plus the earlier phone fixes (tapping a name should start your message, and missing messages). To get that started, say in your private Jarvis chat: "Hand Claude Code the iPhone Jarvis tab and phone message fixes".

Jarvis will ask "Hand this to Claude Code?"; tap "Hand it off" and I'll start right away.
